property.name: hbase.rootdir
property.description: Where HBase keeps everything in HDFS: tables (data/), WALs (WALs/, oldWALs/), archive/.

property.name: hbase.hregion.memstore.flush.size
property.description: A region flushes its MemStores into HFiles once they hold this much data (original: 128 MB).

property.name: hbase.hstore.compactionThreshold
property.description: From this many HFiles in a store a minor compaction starts after a flush (original: 3).

property.name: hbase.hstore.compaction.max
property.description: At most this many files per minor compaction (original: 10).

property.name: hbase.hstore.compaction.ratio
property.description: A file is only selected if it is not larger than ratio x the sum of the newer files (original: 1.2).

property.name: hbase.regionserver.hlog.blocksize
property.description: HDFS block size of WAL files. The WAL is rolled at blocksize x hbase.regionserver.logroll.multiplier (0.5).

property.name: io.storefile.bloom.error.rate
property.description: Target false positive rate of the Bloom filters (original: 0.01).

property.name: zookeeper.session.timeout
property.description: A RegionServer without a heartbeat for this long (ms) is declared dead and its regions are recovered (original: 90000; there ZooKeeper detects it - EduBase has no ZooKeeper).
